shape_hint: Open-end blind (pop) rivet with a 120 degree countersunk (flat conical) head: a straight tubular body of diameter d1 ending in a shallow cone head of top diameter dk and small height k, with the steel break mandrel protruding above the head; the head sits flush in a countersunk hole.

role_map.dk: countersunk head top diameter (DIN symbol d2), max = nominal

notes: Governing numbers are DIN 7337 Form B (withdrawn 1991 edition, replaced by ISO 15978 for d 2.4-5 aluminium/steel). ISO 15978-labelled product pages of Keller-Kalmbach and IERO confirm dk (5/6/6/7.5/9/9 for 2.4/3/3.2/4/4.8/5) but k is only published by DIN 7337 B sources (globalfastener, fasten.it, Westfield). One vendor catalog (fastenersfixingsandtools PDF) prints different ISO 15978 numbers (dk 6.4/7.8/9.5, k up to 1.8); this is the main caveat - verify against the ISO text before drawing precise cone geometry. dk_min is 0.4/0.5/0.7 below dk (5.6, 7, 8.5, 10.3, 11.3) per DIN 7337 B. Closed-end rivets (ISO 15973) are not covered. Hole values for 6/6.4 and 3.2 rely on pages that are not countersunk-specific (the DIN 7337 hole table is common to forms A and B; Westfield's csk page Table 4 confirms it).

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 8 listed URLs live (all HTTP 200) + Keller 3.2/4/4.8/5 pages, IERO 2.4/4.0 pages, Gesipa 3x12/5x8/A2-4.8x12 pages (URLs taken from the producer's raw copies). Parsed with tbl.py. Westfield Table 1 decoded by hand from colspans (columns 2.4,3,3.2,4,4.8,5,6,6.4): k = -,0.9,0.9,1,1.2,1.2,1.5,1.6; d2 = -,6,6,7.5,'p','p',11,12 (4.8/5 garbled, not counted); Table 4 d3 = 2.5,3.1,3.3,4.1,4.9,5.1,6.1,6.5. Matrix 7 rows x {dk,k,d3} x all sources. dk: gf=fasten.it=Westfield(where readable) on every row (6,6,7.5,9,9,11,12). k: gf=fasten.it=Westfield on all 7 rows (exactly 3 clusters, no other HTML source has k). d3 clusters per row (non-PDF, exact number): 3:{W,Gesipa,yiwan,bolts}=4; 3.2:{W,yiwan}=2 FAIL (bolts prints typo 63.3; Keller gives range 3,3-3,4 not a number; fffat PDF not countable); 4:5; 4.8:{W,IERO,Gesipa-A2,yiwan,bolts}=5; 5:{W,Gesipa-5x8,yiwan,bolts}=4; 6:{W,yiwan,bolts}=3; 6.4:{W,yiwan,bolts}=3. dk clusters: 3:5; 4:6; 4.8:{gf,fasten.it,IERO,Keller}=4; 5:{gf,fasten.it,Keller}=3; 6,6.4:{gf,fasten.it,Westfield}=3. Physical: dk,k,d3 monotonic; d3=d1+0.1 on all rows; k matches a 120-deg cone k=(dk-d1)/2/tan60 within 0.09 mm on every row (0.87/0.81/1.01/1.21/1.15/1.44/1.62 vs 0.9/0.9/1.0/1.2/1.2/1.5/1.6).
problems: Row 3.2: d3=3.3 has only 2 valid clusters (Westfield, yiwan). boltsfastener prints '63.3' (typo), Keller prints a range '3,3 - 3,4 mm', fffat PDF cannot count -> row 3.2 dropped (alternative: keep 3.2 and drop column d3).

k column: exactly 3 clusters on every row (globalfastener-cluster, fasten.it, Westfield) = zero margin. The vendor ISO 15978 sheet (fffat.pdf, Al/St) disagrees on k for ALL rows (3:1.1, 3.2:1.1, 4:1.4, 4.8:1.8, 5:1.8 vs 0.9/0.9/1.0/1.2/1.2) and on dk for 3.2 (6.4), 4 (7.8), 4.8 (9.5), 5 (9.5). No HTML ISO-15978 source publishes k. Per T2 the PDF neither adds nor removes a cluster, so k passes, but ONLY as DIN 7337 B 'k approx.' data.

Standard mismatch: catalog family std is ISO 15978 (d 2.4-5) + ISO 15973, but the table is DIN 7337 B (withdrawn 1991). It must be published/labelled as DIN 7337 B, never as ISO 15978. Rows 6 and 6.4 are outside ISO 15978's d range; ISO row 2.4 is absent.

dk rows 4.8 and 5: Gesipa A2 4.8x12 and Steel/Steel 5x8 pages print 9.50 (and fffat PDF 9.5) vs 9 on gf, fasten.it, Keller, IERO. Majority still >=3 (4.8: 4 clusters, 5: 3 clusters) but 5 is thin; a different rivet-material variant may be the cause (unresolved).

d3 rows 6 and 6.4 rest on exactly 3 clusters (Westfield, boltsfastener, yiwan). yiwan.net is a manufacturer blog whose other tables are rules of thumb (solid-rivet dk = 2d, not DIN 660) -> reliability doubtful; boltsfastener/yiwan blind-rivet tables are the DIN 7337 A (dome head) table, so they support only the hole column, not dk/k.

boltsfastener.com page is titled 'countersunk' but its d2/k (6.5/0.8...) are the A-form values -> contradicts dk/k here; not counted for dk/k (also theo-schrauben ISO-15978 page = A-form values, per producer).
Westfield dk for 4.8 and 5 is garbled ('p') in HTML -> not counted for those two cells.
Column d1 duplicates the row label (size); trivial, not a verified measurement. dk key = DIN symbol d2 in fasten.it/Westfield (role read from header, not inferred).

standard_full: DIN 7337 Form B (countersunk 120 deg, open end); ISO 15978 (d 2.4-5) is the successor
